chain_words.translation: having enough money to live without worry
having more money than most people
having a lot of money or valuable possessions
chain_words.nuance: a general state of great wealth

chain_words.translation: having a very large amount of money and property
having a high income and a luxurious lifestyle
chain_words.nuance: a very high level of prosperity, often of a whole community

explanation: These words all describe having money, moving from comfortable financial security to a highly prosperous lifestyle.

usage_notes.difference: 'Rich' is the everyday word for having a lot of money; 'wealthy' is more formal and suggests wealth that has been accumulated over a long period.

translations.comfortable: having enough money to live without worry
translations.well-off: having more money than most people
translations.rich: having a lot of money or valuable possessions
translations.wealthy: having a very large amount of money and property
translations.affluent: having a high income and a luxurious lifestyle
